title: Europe PMC (research)
description: Biomedical and life-science literature from Europe PMC as a research source, declared as a service. Free, no key.
setup_notes: No key needed. Its results link by DOI, which is made into a doi.org address. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then add it under Admin > Extensions > Research Sources, which puts it to use: research asks it on the topics set there (suggested: medical, scientific), and a tool name there offers it to agents through query_source. Or pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as the engine.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; research and Web Search list it by this name.
